summary: Implements Ashigaru Elite's activated, per-battle Force boost (issue #166), the second of the aggregate/group Force effects (after Senior Infantry Legion, #162/PR #163). New MatchState.AshigaruBoost is a per-player counter, incremented once per tireless use of a new ability whose entire cost is bowing an unbowed Farm-keyword Holding (new Target category own-unbowed-farm, a second deliberate exception to the Battle-timing-targets-must-be-at-battlefield check). New AshigaruBattleBoost(card) is read by both PersonalityForce and FollowerForce for any Ashigaru-keyword card AtBattle, and the counter resets to zero in FinishBattleResolution -- for the remainder of the battle, not the turn. Shared-file note: all changed files are within L5R.Core (rules engine) and its test suite, plus docs/ROADMAP.md -- a single rules-lane primitive change; no UI/client files touched. This branch is stacked on mdornbrook/162-unit-force-boost (PR #163, not yet merged -- CI is blocked repo-wide by a GitHub Actions billing issue on the account, unrelated to code) rather than branched independently off main; it will rebase onto main once #163 merges.
validation: New AshigaruEliteBoostPrimitive test: rejects a non-Farm target; one use boosts an Ashigaru Personality and an Ashigaru Follower at the battlefield, leaves a non-Ashigaru card and the enemy's own Ashigaru card unaffected; a second tireless use (a different Farm) stacks; reusing an already-bowed Farm is rejected; the counter resets to 0 once the battle resolves. Full suite: 100/100 core + 34/34 published + 8/8 deck format pass. bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passes (13/13 AI, 5/5 server integration, 4/4 client transport integration).
remaining: Infrastructure only -- no published card needs it yet (Ashigaru Elite is not imported). Utaku Elite Guard is next, per the user's own sequencing: same static 'boost others' shape as Senior Infantry Legion, but keyword-based and army-scoped. 'Negated' (removing this specific counter mid-battle) is not modeled -- no published card needs it yet.
